metadata.title: Aggregate Depth Fit and the 1992 Analogue Scenario

story.iWant: the calibrated pool to stand for the aggregate USDC market, and a scenario parameterised from Black Wednesday in ratio terms
story.soThat: the note can show one fitted parameter against one observation, and the model reproducing the first-generation reserve-exhaustion story
story.tasks: - Depth fit (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Boundary probe (AC: 4) - 1992 scenario (AC: 5–10) - Counterfactual and charts (AC: 11) - ADR, tests, close out (AC: 12, 13)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–13. Part A must be complete and committed before Part B starts; both 1992 scenarios use D*.

dependencies.python: No new dependencies. scripts/ use argparse + pandas.

story-context.constraints: - No config schema changes. No kernel/protocol/agent changes. stop_below_price is NOT used (ADR-0018 amendment). - scripts/ are thin: build a SweepSpec, call run_sweep, read sweep.parquet, print a table. --dry-run prints the grid and exits 0 without running. - D* is chosen by the rule in AC 2; no hand-picking. If the grid needs extending, say so and extend by one decade only. - Every 1992 parameter has a status in the YAML header (verified / secondary / assumption) matching BACKGROUND.md; the attacker multiple and budget:reserves split are assumptions with one-sentence reasoning each. - The 1992 scenario must end reserves_exhausted; the only lever is the attacker multiple (AC 10). Do not touch pace, pool depth, or redemption capacity to force it. - Charts are produced, inspected and described; not committed (2.7). - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: args: --scenario (default scenarios/calibrated-baseline.yaml), --target-bps (default -1300), --workers, --output, --dry-run. Prints the grid table, then "D* = (trough )".

args: --scenario, --ratios (default 0.5,0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5,2.0), --seeds (default 8), --workers, --output, --dry-run. Sets agents[type=attacker].capital = ratio × (budget + reserves) per cell; prints p_* per ratio from mc.parquet.

tests.standards: pytest; both scripts tested with --dry-run only (no sweeps in CI); 1992 scenarios load, hash, and run with max_steps overridden to 500; SOURCES.md status regex; YAML header of each 1992 scenario contains the strings 'verified', 'secondary' or 'assumption' on every parameter line (simple test).

probe_boundary.py --dry-run exits 0 and lists 6 ratios × 8 seeds = 48 cells
soros-1992 and soros-1992-no-defense validate; no-defense has defender budget 1 and spread_adjust 0
calibrated-baseline amm.reserve_stable == amm.reserve_reference == D* after update (read D* from the YAML comment or a constant in the test)
SOURCES.md contains a market_depth_multiple row with status assumption
